question: What is the meaning of flooding in relation to outdoor?
description: Flooding refers to the release of hazardous substances, microplastics, or radiation into outdoor environments, such as air, ground water, marine or surface waters, or soil. This can result from faulty discharge of waste water, emission of flue gases, or faulty disposal of solid or liquid waste. Flooding can also cause damage to buildings, including damage through the transport of water-borne contaminants to the foundations of the building. Flooding is also associated with the release of greenhouse gas emissions into the atmosphere.
